byte_inspection: Pinned image5 ARM instructions fa816c-fa89b8, fa91b0-fa9320, fa95a8-fa992c and f52440-f525ec. Draft C is NONMATCHING for the numerical roots; instruction widths, arguments, history limits, signed arithmetic, ordering and profile offsets were read from these bytes.
scope: 256-cell motion differences and centroid, signed wrapping difference magnitude, iterative displacement estimate, speed and class histories, ordered setting-based filter selection, diagnostic initialization and physical-memory snapshot publication.
corrected_draft_facts: fa8334 accepts its class in r0; fa82fc normalizes it before insertion.
Grid diagnostic count, validity, rate, speed and filter fields are halfwords, not the draft's int-sized overlapping stores.
The centroid y denominator is count multiplied by the high halfword of 74ec30's result.
Differences truncate to signed 16 bits before absolute value; -32768 remains negative when compared to the threshold.
The speed history accumulates modulo 65536 before averaging and requires every requested entry to be initialized.
The profile is a 40-byte global snapshot. 7582c0 ignores r1. The grid updates its first word and halfword at offset4; the filter updates word16 and halfwords20/22.
The class histogram tie is resolved by four settings in their original call order.
Snapshot sample arrays widen signed halfwords into words, while histories and diagnostic halfwords widen unsigned.
Snapshot starts at output+4 and retains output+0 unchanged. The final speed is written at output+0x8d0.
